decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Gengar. Lead Rotom-Mow+Incineroar: turn one Fake Out flinches Swampert/Archaludon while Magnet Thunderbolt guarantees the OHKO on Pelipper (4x) or Gyarados; Leaf Storm guaranteed OHKOs Swampert (4x) and Levitate blanks Earthquake, collapsing their rain mode; Intimidate softens every physical attacker. decisions.notebook: G1 plan locked: lead Rotom-Mow+Incineroar, back Mega Gengar+Kingambit (Skarmory/Noivern benched). Opp roster: Pelipper(DampRock,Drizzle), Swampert(Swampertite→Swift Swim), Archaludon(LifeOrb,Stamina), Grimmsnarl(LightClay,Prankster screens/Fake Out), Gholdengo(Leftovers,Good as Gold,NastyPlot), Gyarados(LumBerry,Intimidate,DD). Likely modes: Pelipper+Swampert rain; Grimmsnarl screens+Gholdengo NP or Gyarados DD. Verified calcs: Rotom Thunderbolt guaranteed OHKO Pelipper & Gyarados (4x), Leaf Storm guaranteed OHKO Swampert (4x); Flare Blitz vs Gholdengo 87-159% (likely OHKO, better vs low-bulk spreads); Gengar Shadow Ball vs Gholdengo 60-108% (2HKO trap). Watch: Rotom is 2x weak to Swampert Ice Punch and Pelipper Hurricane—Fake Out/Intimidate cover turn 1. Rain Swift Swim Mega Swampert (eff. 180-244) outspeeds Mega Gengar—never lead Gengar into rain. Good as Gold blocks Parting Shot/Whirlwind. Kingambit: Iron Head 2x vs Grimmsnarl, Kowtow 2x vs Gholdengo; Archaludon resists both Kingambit STABs—leave Archaludon to Gengar Focus Blast. Stamina means don't chip Archaludon with physical hits.

decisions.rationale: Leaf Storm is a guaranteed OHKO on Swampert; Protect+Mega is mandatory. Incin Fake Out is wasted on Protect. WB Incin is 90-163% in rain (likely KO or Sitrus chip) and pressures the Intim lead while we set up Swift Swim next.

decisions.rationale: Remove the biggest threat: Leaf Storm is a verified guaranteed 4x OHKO on Swampert even post-Mega, and Swift Swim Mega Swampert is the one mon my Gengar/Kingambit backline can't handle. Fake Out Pelipper denies Hurricane/Helping Hand/Weather Ball, so even a 117-Spe Pelipper can't snipe Rotom and Rotom can't be double-targeted down. If Swampert Protects, Pelipper still flinches and I Thunderbolt it t2; if Pelipper Protects, Swampert dies—great trade. Double Protect only costs tempo.

decisions.rationale: Bring Kingambit: it resists Liquidation, Ice Punch, Hurricane and Weather Ball, so only Earthquake (2x) dents it—and EQ is at -1 Atk and hits nothing else (Rotom levitates, Pelipper is immune). Kingambit tanks while full-SpA Rotom threatens guaranteed 4x OHKOs on both foes. Gengar stays back: Swift Swim Swampert outspeeds it and it is 2x EQ-weak; it remains our Gholdengo trap and Archaludon answer for the endgame. Next turn: Protect Rotom if doubled, then delete the rain core.

Black Glasses Kowtow likely KOs Pelipper; Iron Head 2x vs Grimmsnarl; Kowtow 2x vs Gholdengo. decisions.rationale: Swampert outspeeds Rotom and Ice Punches for ~50-94% chip; HH guarantees stronger follow-up. Pelipper dies to Tbolt anyway so donate damage. Avoid EQ ally hit and reduced Protect. Kingambit cannot OHKO Swampert with SP.

Grimm resists KCleave 0.25x, Prankster FO/screens vs remaining threats and Defiant; Gholdengo eats 2x Dark from full HP Kingambit. Rotom -2 Spa 32% less urgent than physical Kingambit. Screens help Pelipper live Electrics.

Remove the Swift Swim engine now: Swampert moves first but only Ice Punch threatens Rotom (~36-63% at -1; HH max-roll barely KOs, unlikely), and EQ/Liquidation are wasted into Levitate/resist. Leaf Storm OHKOs Pert unless its reduced Protect connects; even then no SpA drop and it can't Protect reliably again. Kowtow doesn't KO Pelipper (47-86%) but leaves it in Thunderbolt range for next turn. Doubling up on Swampert wastes damage; killing the support first leaves Pert alive for two more attacks

decisions.rationale: Only Gholdengo remains; must replace one fainted slot and pass the other. Slot a vs weakened Rotom is fine; GaG walls status and specials.

Kingambit Kowtow Cleave is a guaranteed KO on 46% Pelipper regardless of speed order (Hurricane is 0.5x resisted, Kingambit at 100% tanks it). -2 Magnet Tbolt guaranteed-KOs 15% Grimmsnarl, removing the screens bot before Light Screen can blunt Gengar's endgame. Only a 33% Protect saves Pelipper, and it can't outlast repeated Kowtows. Rotom is expendable here; its residual job (4x Tbolt vs Gyarados) is covered by Gengar+Kingambit up 4v2.

decisions.rationale: Only Gholdengo left. Finish weak -2 Rotom with Shadow Ball before it pivots or chips; Kingambit resists Steel/Ghost so MIR weak. Speeds favor us vs Kingambit; Rotom may outspeed. Need KO pressure now.

It's 3v1; Gholdengo is the last foe and moves first. Shadow Ball guaranteed-KOs 32% Rotom, so Protect denies the snipe while Kingambit's Black Glasses STAB Kowtow Cleave (2x SE) lands for 84.5-150.6%—likely ending the game on the spot. If it survives via Recover or low roll, next turn Kowtow/Sucker finishes with Gengar still in reserve. No reason to risk Gengar or donate Rotom.

reflections.adjustment: Change the four: bench Mega Swampert for Gyarados (Intimidate + DD) or Arch so rain still functions without gifting Kingambit a free cleanup lane into Rotom-Mow.

reflections.summary: Won because the Rotom-Mow/Kingambit core hard-countered the rain plan: Leaf Storm KO'd Mega Swampert through rain, then Kingambit's Black Glasses Kowtow Cleave cleaned Pelipper and OHKO'd the no-Protect Gholdengo, while Protect burned Grimmsnarl's entry Fake Out. Incineroar's turn-1 death (Fake Out into an obvious Swampert Protect, then Weather Ball) was inconsequential. The intended Mega Gengar never saw the field — the four brought were right, but the win came entirely from the Rotom/Kingambit
reflections.adjustment: Don't waste Fake Out into the telegraphed turn-1 Swampert Protect — target Pelipper instead to preserve Incineroar for later Intimidate/Parting Shot pivots (never Parting Shot Gholdengo — Good as Gold immune). Expect Archaludon and/or Gyarados in G2: keep Gengar as the Focus Blast answer to Archaludon and Rotom's Thunderbolt for Gyarados, and avoid physical contact into Stamina Archaludon.
